title: The Random sample of the soil
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：random　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 random 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the athlete wrote of ① a random sample of the soil in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② so random that nobody in the stadium would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the random ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the random sample of the soil that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1943 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too random to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the random ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a random choice of the names, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as random as the choice of the names they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was random or not, and he said so.

By 1956 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something random, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite random; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the random ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1959, year after year, she wrote of another random sample of the soil in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less random than anybody had expected. ⑩ The random choice of the names that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1961, was the one she could never quite name; the random ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 随机（前置定语 a random sample of the soil：1949 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件随机的土样）
B. adj. 随机／随意（两处加强说法：so random that … 与 no less random than …）
C. adj. 随机／随意（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 随机（表语 too random to do：母亲觉得它太随机，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 随意（前置定语 a random choice of the names：叔叔把整件事称作一桩随意的名字）
F. adj. 随意（同级比较 as random as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩随意挑中的名字相比）
G. adj. 随意（后置定语 something random：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 随意（受程度副词修饰 quite random：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a random sample of the soil
the random sample of the soil that
a random choice of the names
The random choice of the names that

answers.why: random 意为“随机”，1949 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件随机的土样”，此处作前置定语 a random sample of the soil。
random 意为“随机”，此处用 so random that 结构，说它随机到体育场里没人敢靠近。
random 意为“随机”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的随机随机采取的土样，等于最高级的说法。
random 意为“随机”，母亲认为这件东西“太随机了，谁也用不上”，too random to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
random 意为“随意”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩随意的名字”，此处作前置定语 a random choice of the names。
random 意为“随意”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩随意挑中的名字一样随意”，同级比较用 as random as。
random 意为“随意”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“随意的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something random。
random 意为“随意”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当随意”，quite 修饰原级 random。
random 意为“随意”，no less random than 表示“其随意不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之随意不亚于任何人的预料。
random 意为“随意”，母亲 1961 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的随意名字”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件随机的土样。（a random sample of the soil）
它随机到体育场里没有一个人敢靠近。（so random that …）
母亲觉得它太随机，谁也用不上。（too random to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩随意的名字。（a random choice of the names）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩随意挑中的名字一样随意。（as random as …）
到了 1956 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件随意的东西。（something random）
answers: In 1949 the athlete wrote of a random sample of the soil in the programme.
It was so random that nobody in the stadium would go near it.
My mother thought it too random to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a random choice of the names.
He said nobody would call it as random as the choice of the names they had once had.
By 1956 the programme asked for nothing but something random.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 random 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the athlete wrote of a random sample of the soil in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the random sample of the soil that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too random to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a random choice of the names, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite random, and everybody laughed.
The random ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
